_about: Benzene (1) + Toluene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of benzene, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of benzene, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Li, H.[Hong], Han, M.[Mingen], Gao, X.[Xin], Li, X.[Xingang], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for binary system of cinnamaldehyde + benzaldehyde at 10, 20 and 30 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 364 (2014) 62-66
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5, 6. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0011. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.07 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
